text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Representative Exchange Race, <chrname> 
delivers a powerful performance that 
inspires dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was solely because she had run with 
Sirius Symboli as her goal—even if the 
person herself were to deny it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The announcement of Japan's representative 
team members— <chrname> is brilliantly selected, 
while Sirius Symboli chooses to withdraw.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is all thanks to Sirius Symboli that 
she is here today; <chrname> will prove her 
admiration for her at the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.
